{"type":"assistant","message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5","id":"msg_011CenVDqyisBbQnPgbm4cyY","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"tool_use","id":"toolu_01PNeQrMeZaSLjjE5AY6cbBH","name":"Write","input":{"file_path":"/home/llmtest/evals/20260901-162328/cahn-hilliard_claude-sonnet-5-cc-medium_hybrid_r3/cahn-hilliard/cahn_hilliard.cpp","content":"#include <mpi.h>\n\n#include <algorithm>\n#include <chrono>\n#include <cmath>\n#include <cstdio>\n#include <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include <cuda_runtime.h>\n#include <omp.h>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n#define CUDA_CHECK(call)                                                                 \\\n    do {                                                                                 \\\n        cudaError_t _err = (call);                                                       \\\n        if (_err != cudaSuccess) {                                                       \\\n            fprintf(stderr, \"CUDA error %s at %s:%d\\n\", cudaGetErrorString(_err),         \\\n                    __FILE__, __LINE__);                                                 \\\n            MPI_Abort(MPI_COMM_WORLD, 1);                                                \\\n        }                                                                                 \\\n    } while (0)\n\n// 3D index calculation (z is the outermost/slowest-varying dimension, so a\n// plane of constant z is contiguous in memory - this is what makes the\n// halo exchange below a simple contiguous memcpy).\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Compute Laplacian for a cell (x, y, zl) of the local sub-domain.\n// The local buffer holds nzl interior planes plus one ghost plane below\n// (zl == 0) and one ghost plane above (zl == nzl + 1); those ghost planes\n// are always populated (via halo exchange with the MPI neighbor, or by a\n// clamped copy of the adjacent interior plane at the global domain edge)\n// before this is called, so no special-casing of the z direction is needed.\n__device__ inline double deviceLaplacian(const double* __restrict__ c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny,\n                                         const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                                         const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t zl) {\n    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t zp = zl + 1;\n    const size_t zn = zl - 1;\n\n    const size_t plane = nx * ny;\n    const size_t base = zl * plane + y * nx + x;\n    const double cv = c[base];\n\n    const double cxx = (c[zl * plane + y * nx + xp] + c[zl * plane + y * nx + xn] - 2.0 * cv) / (dx * dx);\n    const double cyy = (c[zl * plane + yp * nx + x] + c[zl * plane + yn * nx + x] - 2.0 * cv) / (dy * dy);\n    const double czz = (c[zp * plane + y * nx + x] + c[zn * plane + y * nx + x] - <cstdlib>\n#include <cstring>\n#include <vector>\n\n#include \"../common/results_output.hpp\"\n\n// 3D index calculation\ninline constexpr size_t idx3(const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z, const size_t nx, const size_t ny) noexcept {\n    return z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n}\n\n// Compute Laplacian with clamped boundary conditions\ndouble computeLaplacian(const std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double dx, const double dy, const double dz, const size_t x, const size_t y, const size_t z) {\n    const size_t xp = (x < nx - 1) ? x + 1 : x;\n    const size_t yp = (y < ny - 1) ? y + 1 : y;\n    const size_t zp = (z < nz - 1) ? z + 1 : z;\n    const size_t xn = (x > 0) ? x - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t yn = (y > 0) ? y - 1 : 0;\n    const size_t zn = (z > 0) ? z - 1 : 0;\n    \n    const double cxx = (c[idx3(xp, y, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(xn, y, z, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dx * dx);\n    const double cyy = (c[idx3(x, yp, z, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, yn, z, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dy * dy);\n    const double czz = (c[idx3(x, y, zp, nx, ny)] + c[idx3(x, y, zn, nx, ny)] - \n                  2.0 * c[idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny)]) / (dz * dz);\n    \n    return cxx + cyy + czz;\n}\n\n// Compute chemical potential\nvoid computeChemicalPotential(const std::vector<double>& c, std::vector<double>& mu,\n                              const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                              const double dx, const double dy, const double dz,\n                              const double gamma, const double e_AA, const double e_BB, const double e_AB) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                const double cv = c[idx];\n                \n                mu[idx] = 4.5 * ((cv + 1.0) * e_AA + (cv - 1.0) * e_BB - 2.0 * cv * e_AB) \n                         + 3.0 * cv + cv * cv * cv\n                         - gamma * computeLaplacian(c, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Cahn-Hilliard update step\nvoid cahnHilliardUpdate(std::vector<double>& cnew, const std::vector<double>& cold,\n                        const std::vector<double>& mu,\n                        const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz,\n                        const double D, const double dt, const double dx, const double dy, const double dz) {\n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                cnew[idx] = cold[idx] + dt * D * \n                           computeLaplacian(mu, nx, ny, nz, dx, dy, dz, x, y, z);\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\n// Initialize concentration field\nvoid initializeConcentration(std::vector<double>& c, const size_t nx, const size_t ny, const size_t nz) {\n    const size_t vol = nx * ny * nz;\n    \n    for (size_t z = 0; z < nz; ++z) {\n        for (size_t y = 0; y < ny; ++y) {\n            for (size_t x = 0; x < nx; ++x) {\n                const size_t idx = idx3(x, y, z, nx, ny);\n                // Generate pseudo-random value in [-1, 1]\n                const size_t linear_id = z * (nx * ny) + y * nx + x;\n                const double pseudo = ((((linear_id + 1) * 1299709) % vol) / static_cast<double>(vol));\n                c[idx] = -1.0 + 2.0 * pseudo;\n            }\n        }\n    }\n}\n\nbool validateResult(const std::vector<double>& c, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nx, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t ny, [[maybe_unused]] const size_t nz) {\n    // Check for NaN or Inf\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        if (std::isnan(val) || std::isinf(val)) {\n            printf(\"Validation failed: found NaN or Inf value\\n\");\n            return false;\n        }\n    }\n    \n    // Check if values are in reasonable range for concentration field\n    // After Cahn-Hilliard evolution, values should typically remain bounded\n    double minVal = c[0];\n    double maxVal = c[0];\n    for (const auto& val : c) {\n        minVal = std::min(minVal, val);\n        maxVal = std::max(maxVal, val);\n    }\n    \n    printf(\"Concentration range: [%.6f, %.6f]\\n\", minVal, maxVal);\n    \n    // Values should generally stay within reasonable bounds\n    if (maxVal > 10.0 || minVal < -10.0) {\n        printf(\"Validation failed: values out of expected range\\n\");\n        return false;\n    }\n    \n    return true;\n}\n\nvoid printUsage(const char* progName) {\n    printf(\"Usage: %s [options]\\n\", progName);\n    printf(\"Options:\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -x <num>     Grid size in X dimension (default: 64)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -y <num>     Grid size in Y dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -z <num>     Grid size in Z dimension (default: same as X)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -i <num>     Number of time steps (default: 20)\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -v           Enable validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -r           Print results for external validation\\n\");\n    printf(\"  -h           Show this help message\\n\");\n}\n\nint main(int argc, char** argv) {\n    size_t nx = 64;\n    size_t ny = 0;\n    size_t nz = 0;\n    int iterations = 20;\n    bool validate = false;\n    bool printResults = false;\n    \n    // Parse command line The hybrid MPI+OpenMP+CUDA implementation is verified bit-identical to the original serial semantics across 1, 2, 3, 4, and 8 ranks, with correct error handling for edge cases.\n\n## Summary\n\nRewrote `cahn_hilliard.cpp` and `CMakeLists.txt` for a hybrid MPI + OpenMP + CUDA design:\n\n- **MPI**: domain-decomposes the grid into contiguous z-slabs across ranks, with async halo exchange of ghost planes between neighbors (`MPI_PROC_NULL` handles domain edges automatically, falling back to the original clamped-boundary copy).\n- **CUDA**: each rank binds to a GPU (round-robin by node-local rank) and runs the chemical-potential and update stencils as kernels operating on the local slab plus ghost cells — no per-step host/device transfer of the interior data.\n- **OpenMP**: parallelizes host-side work — field initialization and final validation (min/max/NaN reduction).\n- Final field is gathered via `MPI_Gatherv` into the original global layout so `print_results`/`validateResult` run unchanged and produce **bit-identical output** to the serial version, verified across 1–8 ranks and uneven decompositions.\n\nBuild now requires `CXX CUDA` languages plus `MPI`/`OpenMP` in CMake; verified a clean build and correctness/error-path tests, all passing."}],"stop_reason":null,"stop_sequence":null,"stop_details":null,"usage":{"input_tokens":2,"cache_creation_input_tokens":319,"cache_read_input_tokens":57276,"cache_creation":{"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":319},"output_tokens":2,"service_tier":"standard","inference_geo":"not_available"},"diagnostics":null,"context_management":null},"parent_tool_use_id":null,"session_id":"3fa082d1-4a80-4493-9b0f-e3b03c21cdf3","uuid":"ed6b4ac4-cc42-4a9d-ab5b-1c8bb5d7bf3f","timestamp":"2026-09-06T16:22:44.554Z","request_id":"req_011CenVbJ8RG1Nh4JJZaZoR6"}
